label: X440-G2-48t-10GE4
description: ExtremeSwitching X440-G2-48t-10GE4 (16702) - 1RU edge switch, ExtremeXOS: 48x 10/100/1000BASE-T RJ45 (ports 1:1-1:48, four of which double as 1G SFP combo ports) plus 4x rear SFP+ uplinks (ports 1:49-1:52) that run 1G by default and 10G with the 10Gb upgrade licence.
